448	So I went to his synagogue, in the middle of Petach Tikva.	Então fui à sinagoga dele, no meio de Petach Tikva.

453	OK?	Certo?
454	Why am I remembering this?	Por que estou me lembrando disso?
455	Because once I went with a few rabbis to visit a Muslim sheikh, a Sufi,	Porque uma vez fui com alguns rabinos visitar um xeique muçulmano, um sufi,

459	of the friends had their feet pointed like this, they didn't sit Eastern style, they sat with their legs	dos colegas estavam com os pés virados assim, não sentaram à moda oriental, sentaram com as pernas
